comparison.objective: Torques a busbar lug bolt with a click wrench and stops at the click; the candidate establishes and locks an angular stop setting.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1501 tests socket seating and response to a one-shot torque signal without overpulling; the candidate tests simultaneous driver and thin-wrench countertorque on coupled threads.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1501 requires a seated click within 90–110% of target torque and penalizes unseated turning or overtorque; the candidate requires retained geometry and repeated gripper actuation rather than a torque endpoint.
comparison.reason: Applying a specified tightening torque is materially different from preserving an adjustable screw position while tightening its jam nut.

review_notes: Busbar bolt click torque wrench, all versions: torque threshold versus preserving coupled adjustment.
